normalized.description:
The downrange stations are an essential element during the launcher mission as they ensure the launcher-to-ground communication links capability. Ever since the beginning, the CSG Range has been implementing a network of downrange telemetry stations to support Ariane and then Vega launches.
This project consists in the replacement of aged large antennas in a gradual approach, beginning with the SNA Stella 35 and then continuing with others (eg. Galliot’s or Bermuda’s ones). This replacement is now essential to maintain CSG Range availability. To optimize costs, the approach consists in proposing a set of identical and smaller antennas (diameter about 4m), allowing a predictive maintenance policy to come.
